raw_market.question: Will Alex Bowman win the 2026 NASCAR Cup Series Bank of America 400?
raw_market.description:
This is a Polymarket on the winner of the 2026 NASCAR Cup Series Bank of America 400, scheduled for Oct 11, 2026.

If the 2026 NASCAR Cup Series Bank of America 400 is canceled or rescheduled to a date 7 days after the original scheduled date, this market will resolve to "Other."

This market will resolve in favor of the driver who is officially listed in first place in the Official Race Results published by NASCAR following the conclusion of the race. Disqualifications or changes made after the publication of the official results will not affect market resolution. The timing of the victory lane ceremony does not determine the result for this market — only NASCAR's published results will be used to resolve this market.

The resolution source will be the official NASCAR website (nascar.com) and a consensus of credible sports news reporting.
